description: [compact alias of query_class_info] Get detailed information about a specific Godot class: methods, properties, signals, enums. Use to discover available properties before calling add_node/create_resource/set_node_properties, or to find methods before call_runtime_method.

includeInherited.description: If true, include inherited members from parent classes (default: false — shows only class-specific members)

projectPath.description: Absolute path to project directory containing project.godot.

name: class-info
